title: Ali Ne Paani Kaise Piya? 💧 | Paani Peene Ki Sunnat | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Ali garmi mein bhaag kar aaya aur khade khade ek saans mein paani pee gaya! Dadu ne sikhaya paani peene ka sunnat tareeqa. 💧🤲

📖 Hadith:
Anas ibn Malik (RA) se riwayat hai: "Nabi ﷺ paani peete waqt teen baar saans lete the." (bartan se bahar saans lete the)
— Sahih Bukhari 5631, Sahih Muslim 2028 (Sahih)

✅ Baith kar piyo
✅ Bismillah keh kar piyo
✅ Teen saans mein piyo

Apne bachchon ke saath zaroor dekhein. Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah ko subscribe karein ❤️
